_about: Shared SHSAT quiz gate payloads (spec 5.2). Copied verbatim by the platform tests (5.6 H).
Every "valid" body must pass the site validateQuizPayload and the platform shsatQuizLeadSchema.
Every "invalid" body must be refused by both, except entries marked site_only.
"field" is the field the site returns; "platform_field" is the field the platform route returns (only parent_name, phone or parent_email, else null).
Test data only: example.com addresses and 555-01xx numbers.

uuid_fallback.about: Output of the crypto.getRandomValues fallback in spec 5.1 for these 16 bytes (version and variant bits set).

valid.name: grade 5, not_sure alone, no attribution, no company_name, no delivery
grade 9, all eight schools, tutor, copy_only
quiz_id from the crypto.getRandomValues fallback (uuid_fallback below)
student_grade as a numeric string (the platform coerces it)
email with capitals and surrounding spaces
a non-string attribution value is accepted and dropped
honeypot filled (valid shape; the backend treats it as a honeypot hit)

invalid.name: parent_email is a school account (@nycstudents.net)
invalid.note: The platform refuses it in the core (5.6 C2 step 1), not in zod, so its 400 may carry no field.

invalid.name: parent_email is a near miss of the school domain (@nycstudent.net)
invalid.note: Refused by the site; the platform refuses it only if its school check covers near misses.

invalid.name: quiz.targets unknown code (LaGuardia is not an SHSAT school)
quiz.targets not_sure combined with a school
